items.title: OCC Imposes $750 Million Assessment Against Bank of America for Deficient BSA/AML Compliance
items.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today announced a $750 million civil money penalty against Bank of America, N.A. (bank), for violations of the Bank Secrecy Act and its implementing regulations, including 12 CFR 21.21 and 12 CFR 21.11. This amount is the largest in OCC history.

items.title: OCC Assesses $350 Million Civil Money Penalty Against American Express
items.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today announced a cease-and-desist order and a $350 million civil money penalty against American Express National Bank, Sandy, Utah (bank), for deficiencies in the bank's Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and anti-money laundering (AML) compliance program.
